title: Action target binding common definitions
description: Definitions shared by the Action target bindings.

ValueToken.description: One part of a target parameter value: literal text or a reference to an Action parameter.

type.description: The token kind. Determines the other allowed properties.

parameterName.description: Name of the Action parameter whose value is used. It must match the name of a parameter in actionParameters. This is validated by the service when the Action is created or imported.

SimpleValueToken.description: A literal text part of the value.

type.description: The token kind. Determines the other allowed properties. Must be 'SimpleValue'.

ParameterReferenceToken.description: The value of an Action parameter, supplied when the Action runs. A missing value resolves to an empty string.

type.description: The token kind. Determines the other allowed properties. Must be 'ParameterReference'.

parameterName.description: Name of the Action parameter whose value is used. It must match the name of a parameter in actionParameters. This is validated by the service when the Action is created or imported.

NameValueTokens.description: A named target parameter. Its value is a list of tokens that are resolved and concatenated in order when the Action runs.

value.description: Parameter value: tokens resolved and concatenated in order. The resolved value (all tokens concatenated) must not exceed 500 characters. This is validated by the service when the Action runs.
